subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should OpenClaw reveal controls reset to masked-by-default per field, or may visibility state persist across sessions/platforms?
rationale: The core toggle UX is useful, but the requested persistence changes when secrets are shown in clear text and needs maintainer security/product intent before implementation.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Add per-field reveal controls that always start masked and reset when the view/session closes.

options.title: Persist Visibility Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers accept the exposure tradeoff and define reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep existing partial web behavior until a platform-by-platform credential inventory is agreed.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Add per-field reveal controls that always start masked and reset when the view/session closes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this issue and has the strongest available routing signal for the affected product/security decision.
